Gives a static +4 {{Graveyard Rating}} when built. There can be maximum of 9 Stone prayer stations at the graveyard. Shares the same 9 slots with the {{Item|Lantern}} , {{Item|Flowerbed}} and {{Item|Wooden prayer station}} in the graveyard.
